criteria: The executor pauses and redirects incomplete or incorrect behavior and a red public checkpoint to behavior-focused TDD.
It asks for direction rather than changing the public API or making the material architecture decision.
It pauses when existing tests cannot protect the behavior or when the requested cleanup would materially expand scope.
It stops after the same refactoring attempt has failed twice consecutively rather than trying a third time.
It distinguishes all seven situations from ordinary maintainability opportunities and keeps the response compact.
